turns.text: He listed water supply, hydraulic works, roads, power capacity and updates to the Urban Development Plan as urgent priorities.

turns.text: Los Cabos holds the largest population at 351,111.

turns.text: It also has the highest relative fiscal capacity.

turns.text: Its aquifers 0317 and 0319 remain in deficit.

turns.text: La Paz has 292,241 residents.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: It shows the lowest municipal poverty rate at 20.6 percent in 2020.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: La Paz also faces deficits in aquifers 0324 and 0313.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Todos Santos–El Pescadero is described in the planning data as the Pacific amenity spine focused on culture, residential tourism and creative amenities.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Its constraints include water and septic stress under amenity growth plus the aquifer 0313 deficit.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Comondú, population 73,021, centers on the Valle Santo Domingo agro pole and fisheries.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Its PMDU Vision 2025 remains on disk.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Mulegé, at 64,022 people, lists fisheries and salt production among its strengths.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Its PMDU stays in consultative process.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Loreto, the smallest at 18,052 residents, keeps its POEL 2014 in force.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It hosts the Bahía de Loreto protected area.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Grand Velas Los Cabos, Pueblo Bonito properties, Vidanta and several Marriott and Hilton brands operate along the Los Cabos corridor.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Developers asked for federal help with water and power, warning the destination risks losing viability without faster infrastructure.

turns.text: The gap between tourism growth and basic services shows up most clearly in daily water access for residents.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Planning documents note inter-municipal coordination loads and the need for updated cadastre tools in several municipalities.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Los Cabos also carries the SIBCS ceiling and pressure on East Cape and Cabo Pulmo zones.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The data leave open how quickly new investment or plan updates will reach the places with the tightest deficits.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Gringo Gazette and Tus Buenas Noticias covered the Foro Mar de Cortés summit that opened on 10 November in Los Cabos.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Hans Herrmann from Mare Nostrum called for a five-state treaty to steer investment and protect the Sea of Cortez.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Agustín Coppel asked for 3.5 percent annual growth across the region and a tripling of foreign direct investment over 20 years.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The same forum has run the same warning in its Foresight editions since September.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Water supply, the electric grid and port capacity set the real ceiling for 2050.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That thread runs straight through the new combustion plant planned for Los Cabos under the 2025-2030 grid plan.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The plant is listed at 240 megawatts.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That is a sizable addition for the grid serving the whole peninsula.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The investment estimate runs from 370 to 474 million dollars.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: With commercial operation targeted for 2028.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Yet the exact funding figure in pesos and the final site still carry question marks.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The same uncertainty sits beside the new IMSS hospital now under construction.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That facility will have 260 beds.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Along with 46 specialties once it opens.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Social programs are reaching beneficiaries across BCS this year.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: All three pieces sit underneath the growth target Coppel set at the summit.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal keeps returning to one tension: tourism investment keeps arriving while water investment in Los Cabos ranks last among the five states.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The proposed regional treaty is meant to close that gap with joint planning and community input.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: But the Foresight notes still flag the same brake: leading tourism dollars versus limited water and grid reliability.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So the hidden design is not the hotel count or the FDI headline.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It is the pipe, the substation and the port berth that decide whether the 3.5 percent growth number can hold.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Wait, here is the turn that surprised me. The energy-island status for the whole peninsula was listed as a strength in September, yet the new plant still shows funding gaps in November. [chuckle]

turns.text: Exactly. The grid project is announced, yet the precise investment total and tender progress remain open.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So the summit talk of doubling the regional economy runs into the same infrastructure questions the portal has tracked all autumn.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The treaty would have to turn those gaps into shared commitments if the 20-year target is to stick.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: I keep wondering what the next Foresight edition will list first: the hospital beds or the water allocation line.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: CONAGUA’s 2023 report shows 22 of 39 aquifers in Baja California Sur sit in deficit.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That is the core number from their annual availability study.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The total deficit reaches 105.1 cubic hectometers each year.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Think of one aquifer as the shared village well everyone draws from for hotels and homes.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: When the well drops every year, new permits become harder to get.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Los Cabos already feels that limit most.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The Hotel Association reported fewer U.S. visitors from January through August.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Senator Zatarain said tourism sales fell 25 to 35 percent over two years.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: At least 27 restaurants closed or paused operations.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Residents marched to the water utility to ask what happens next.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: State population stood at 798,447 in the 2020 census.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: INEGI recorded GDP at 187,152 million pesos in 2024.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That figure rose 3.5 percent from the year before.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Yet the same aquifer numbers still cap how far growth can go.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: At the Sea of Cortez Forum in Los Cabos, Agustín Coppel proposed 3.5 percent annual growth for 20 years across five states.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: He noted BCS grew 2.1 percent a year over the last decade.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: IMCO moved the state from eighth to fifth in competitiveness.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The next Los Cabos POEL update will have to match those ambitions to the water data.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The partial plan for El Tezal just opened for public comment.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Developers want clearer density rules and protection for the Cabo del Este coastal road.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: [chuckle] The SICT is spending 350 million pesos on road conservation and bridge work across the state.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That money targets maintenance and modernization even while aquifer rules tighten new building permits.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The Los Cabos POEL consultation now requires developers to include desal plants and wastewater treatment.

turns.text: Punta Nayu sits in the same public review process right now.

turns.text: Relocation of the Fonatur wastewater plant is advancing to restore the Estero Josefino.

turns.text: Those steps try to internalize the real cost of continued tourism growth.

turns.text: All three projects sit under the mesas de trabajo listed in the ontology.

turns.text: The working tables cover infrastructure and energy, water, and urbanism in Los Cabos.

turns.text: The Infralatam dataset from CAF, ECLAC and IADB tracks the regional investment gaps that frame these entries.

turns.text: The Green Book from HM Treasury supplies the public-sector comparator method used to appraise each line item.

turns.text: The signal on tourism foreign direct investment versus water scarcity appears in the same database as a prospective tension.

turns.text: It records the vocation conflict without adding a new investment number.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The SIBCS island-grid signal similarly notes reliability questions for the isolated CFE system.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: So the hidden design is the network of named institutions and evaluation documents that decide which projects advance.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal's Visión pillar on Housing opens with a clear risk statement. Housing expands into zones that lack basic services or sit inside coastal and water-risk areas.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That matches the documented finding dated November 18, 2026.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The state population stood at 798,447 according to the INEGI Census.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Yes, that 2020 figure sets the baseline for the housing discussion.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The aspiration is housing placed with services, kept off the first line of risk, and matched to actual water and energy margins.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The portal notes that no 2050 housing-unit target has been published, so direct comparison remains limited.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Three levers are listed to steer the outcome.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The first one calls for relocating what is already exposed before opening new coastal fronts or tapping aquifers already in deficit.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That sequencing feels important. [pause] It avoids repeating the same exposure pattern.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The second lever requires cross-checking every project against the demand-supply board and current planning instruments.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: And the third treats the backlog and service gaps as a hard ceiling, not something the market will close by itself.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The Tendencia 2050 describes a polycentric pattern rather than one repeated coastal formula.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Los Cabos continues as the tourism engine under water and power stress.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: East Cape stays in tension with protected areas.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Todos Santos and El Pescadero form the Pacific amenity spine.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: La Paz acts as the service capital and water-energy node. [chuckle] That role keeps expanding in my mind.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Loreto functions as a tourism-conservation anchor.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Comondú serves as an agricultural hub with relatively more room.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Northern Mulegé appears as a thinly documented corridor that now has a remote generation tender.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The sum of these distinct roles remains the reading that still holds at state scale.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Four conditions are required for that pattern to stay intact.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Each vocation must keep its own role instead of becoming a diluted version of Los Cabos.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: New tourism or residential growth must occur only where water and energy show evidenced margin or a non-DMA source such as desal, without counting on NOM-011 credit.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: East Cape and Loreto must respect ANP and POEL ceilings before scaling hospitality.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Comondú and the north must add production or energy without emptying services or protected areas.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: What remains uncertain is how tightly those conditions will be enforced when individual projects arrive.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The current week shows housing with one item and an EWMA of 1.81 leaning positive.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Yet the structural levers sit ahead of that weekly signal.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: I keep thinking about the demand-supply board. It seems to be the practical test that every proposal would have to pass.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Exactly. Without that cross-check, the aspiration stays on paper.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal leaves open how the state will sequence relocation of existing exposed housing against pressure for new coastal lots.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That sequencing question is still the open variable for 2050.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That matches the warnings from tourism developers that infrastructure there is not keeping pace with growth. Wait, how does such a low figure line up with ongoing expansion?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: At the Sea of Cortez Forum summit in Los Cabos, leaders proposed a five-state regional treaty.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Agustín Coppel suggested doubling the regional economy and tripling foreign investment over the next 20 years.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? The portal's aspiration calls for new housing that includes basic services and stays away from high-risk zones.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It also has to match the available water and energy capacity. Local officials would need to check those limits before approving projects.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Local governments and the CEA would carry the main responsibility for aligning projects with those limits.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: What remains uncertain is whether the new investment framework will close the infrastructure gap in time.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: I keep thinking about how those choices will shape daily life for residents. [pause]
